english.note: Use this when someone unfairly favors a particular person or side, especially in a dispute or competition.

examples.english: Mum is always partial to my younger brother.
examples.jyutping: aa3 maa1 seng4 jat6 pin1 sam1 sai3 lou2

english.note: Use this in geometry or engineering when an object or centre is offset rather than aligned.

examples.english: This shaft is slightly eccentric, so it vibrates when it turns.
examples.traditional: 呢條軸心有啲偏心，轉起上嚟會震。
examples.jyutping: ne1 tiu4 zuk6 sam1 jau5 di1 pin1 sam1 zyun2 hei2 soeng5 lai4 wui5 zan3
